versions.changelog:
- Updated confirmation flow: "服务协议" (agree_terms) after registration now requires no manual user input—sign is triggered by tool call; confirmation phrases for no-refund and disclaimer must still be typed verbatim by the user.
- Clarified step order: Mandated that after login, the full disclaimer from sign_in response must be shown verbatim before requesting confirmation.
- Enhanced payment QR code guidance: Agent should attempt to display the QR code image directly (where supported), but must always include the raw URL and related instructions as fallback.
- Improved instructions on parameter handling: pay_method (trc20/erc20/aptos) must be explicitly chosen by the user, not auto-selected by the agent.
- Updated tool quick reference and conversation scripts to reflect these process changes and new confirmation behaviors.
- Removed skill-card.md; consolidated and expanded guidance in other documentation.

This service provides account procurement services for platforms including, but not limited to, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube, Pinterest, Google Business Profiles, Emails, Threads, Snapchat, Bluesky, WhatsApp, Meta Ads, and Discord.
Disclaimer:
The accounts procured through this service are strictly for educational and testing purposes only. Engaging in any illegal activities is strictly prohibited. Any consequences arising from such violations are solely the user's responsibility. This site will fully cooperate with relevant authorities to combat illegal activities.
